rationale: The agent verified the user’s identity using full name and ZIP, matched to a single account. It checked the suggested order and correctly determined it did not contain a camera, then used the user’s order list to find the delivered order with the digital camera. Before performing any change, the agent explicitly asked for confirmation to return the camera and refund to the original payment method. After receiving consent, it submitted the return for the correct item and order, specifying the original Mastercard used, and reported the return request status accurately. No writes were performed without confirmation, actions were taken only on the authenticated user’s account, and information stated matched tool outputs. Minor generic note about return email instructions is typical and not contradictory to tool results. Overall, the request was completed in line with the policy.
